During the [[Great Hunt (Jedi)|Great Hunt]], this '''[[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]''' served as part of a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] hunting group that tracked and [[Death/Legends|killed]] [[Terentatek/Legends|terentateks]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. On one such [[Cleansing of Tatooine|mission]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], this Jedi was killed by a terentatek.<ref name="shadows" />
